summary: The Backrooms is a persistent survival RPG across authored maze levels, player-specific rooms, and shared destinations such as the Bonus Room mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; place simulations and scenes provide local environments, while shared systems own combat, NPCs, loot, building, dialogue, and avatar presentation. Zenith Survey leads from Kade to the sealed far-east breach in Level 0 and onward into Zenith Station; Level 0 smilers and lurkers now patrol toward nearby wanderers, pause to listen, and search around a lost target before resuming patrol.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with shops, landmarks, simulated staff/shoppers, arcade games, and Glow Up Salon styling stations.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture and loot, safe-room systems, shifting walls, creature ecology, route guidance, Kade, and Zenith's sealed far-east breach.
places/level01 (3D) - Level 0.1, Zenith Station: versioned station/gallery, doors, breakables, bots/hazards, climate rooms, flight-recorder quest, and drones.
places/intake (3D) + places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral 3D) - bedroom character-creation/waking space and authored tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.

places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams, and Locked; Level 2 uses Tripo props over its collider shell and placed survivor head attachments; Level 2.1 has Base Alef and its authored route.

places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office, and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems, Boiler Room rats, and climbable library ladders.

places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11, places/level26 (3D) - later authored levels; Level 7 sea/islands and forts, Level 10 silo, Level 11 city, Level 26 SS Fun =) liner in green fog.
places/debug, places/spamton, and remaining configured places (3D) - debug mannequin/body gallery and switch pad, Spamton's fight space, and auxiliary routes.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, and ordered behavior composition; climb.js runs after swim.js.

places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements, and local generated/ticked behavior; main sim owns Level 0 generation and place sims own local layouts/rebuilds/ticks.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene driver, BODIES toggle, and solo-place pause time-scale.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and waking sequence; tutorial scene and tut0 scripts own its route and beats.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - camera and third-person toggle; scripts/ui.js and specialized UI scripts present HUD and panels.
places/debug/cells/x1z0.scene + scripts/dbg-pose.js + scripts/dbg-bodypad.js - clip-gallery mannequins and in-world body-style switch.

places/level01/sim.js - versioned Level 0.1 layout, station furniture/door initialization, modeled furniture substitution, gallery recorder bay and drones; scripts/zenith-geo.js supplies procedural station and Level 0 bulkhead/stanchion pieces.

art/human-base/build.py + art/human-head/* + art/human-face/* + art/human-cloth/* + art/human-hair/build.py + art/tripo-hair/refit.py - offline human rig, heads/expressions, fitted wardrobe meshes and validation.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings, and last-level names including level01; routing and hub handlers use it.

scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, and weapon definitions/rarity reused by search and combat; cells feed Zenith laser weapons.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction; CRT TV builds attach scripts/built-tv.js.

scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only panel classifier and wrist gates shared by player, stats, craft, rest, menu input, and vmpose hand-visibility rules; scripts/lib/footsteps.js handles player surface stride sounds.
scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/level*.js + level data - grids, zones, layouts, and paths reused by place simulations, geometry, and navigation.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + wardrobe.yml + critter.yml/faces.yml/hair.yml/critter-models.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - clothing loot/armor, deterministic looks, named wardrobe meshes, species/head/hair presentation and restyling.
scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml - shared third-person stance and combat animation channels for player and M.E.G. agents; pistol/long families include Zenith laser weapons.

scripts/lib/stats.js + scripts/lib/ballistics.js + scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - weapon handling/ammo, skill scaling, projectile hits, and presentation across player viewmodels, loot, and NPC-held weapons.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - rarityIdx, rarityCap and weapon registry.
scripts/lib/l2props.js - PROPS, fitBox, spawnProp, dressRoom, dressHall, containerModel, crateModel.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, and fishing handlers; scripts/lib/footsteps.js - surfaceUnder, stepTick.
scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - body/face/head/spec, wardrobe fitting/restyling helpers, STYLE_V sw30.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.

scripts/lib/zenith-quest.js - KADE, ZEN_ENTRY, setZen, migrateZen, handleDialogueQuestZ, zenithChoice, layZenithEntry; scripts/zenith-use.js - ears, onSpawn, slide, grab, gone; scripts/zenith-scout.js - onTriggerEnter.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo (including cells), needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, wakeAtSave restoration, and heat/cold meters.

scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, and throw/carry session fields; kick.js also owns the transient first-person leg swing; target body state.heldBy/down controls holding.
scripts/lib/loose.js - arms matched props with state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and owns broke/act effects; per-player session.loose tracks kicked/thrown item flights until impact.
scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lurkers.js - down/kb and thrown/overboard recovery records; enemy managers retain AI state, while lurkers own caught-player lurkHold and entity grab/frenzy/prey state.
scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; homeKeep.built persists home builds reconstructed by home sim.
scripts/hub.js - mall offer/shop/food and room-hop flags plus player trainHid/stungUntil; session.ride/rideTrain holds transient transit scene and spawned train.

scripts/climb.js owns local climb session/player.state.climbing and first-person arm viewmodel; scripts/lib/vmpose.js records session.vmHidKey and controls viewmodel visibility from scene/camera/screen context.

scripts/lib/zenith-quest.js + places/main/sim.js + places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-use.js - player zenQ/zenV/zenKey/zenDrive progression, versioned breach and station layout/drive bay, recorder animation state, and local drone/climate state.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; UI renders mainMenu(ctx, player) when menuOpen; solo pause sets place.timeScale.
scripts/main-menu.js BODIES action or debug pad → world.state.bodyStyle (menu also persists player.state.bodyStyle); root sim.js/critter.js select avatar and restyle occupants via critter-model.js.

scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings and roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume; hub.js hubOffer → hub-ui.js and mall counters write shop/food state for handlers and UI.
Teleport Station UI in scripts/hub-ui.js renders lastLevel(s) from scripts/lib/hub.js; travel requests reach scripts/lib/hub.js, which boards the player via bc-train and crosses to the destination.

Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are level 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; pickups, including cells, enter player.js inventory.

H input → scripts/kick.js attempts foe/loose-object kick and spawns the first-person leg swing when not third-person; Z input → scripts/grab.js carries/throws eligible bodies and calls loose.js arm/track/impact.

Player and M.E.G. combat handlers → scripts/lib/body3.js stance/swing/fire/aim/reload → combat-anims.yml; scripts/lib/stats.js and ballistics.js apply weapon skill/handling, with energy weapons consuming cells.

Zenith Survey: Level 0 sim calls lib/zenith-quest.js layZenithEntry for the versioned far-east bulkhead breach, warning sign, tape posts and Kade; zenith-scout.js advances zenQ 1→2 on approach, Kade dialogue grants zenKey and sets step 3, then station interactions continue the quest.

scripts/lib/vmpose.js reads scripts/lib/screen.js screen classification, place, player cutscene flags, ride state and camera ownership → viewmodel.visible; arms stay hidden in cutscene/menu/wardrobe/mahjong, bonus/intake, Level 26 scene and other blocked contexts.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/mall-shopper.js + scripts/salon-stylist.js/scripts/salon-ui.js - authored mall shops/landmarks and simulated mall life; salon chairs queue sitters and styling UI handles changes.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence, and rebuild path; CRT TV builds attach screen, sound, and glow.

art/level0/build.py + art/level1/paint.py/build.py/props.py/props_paint.py + art/level2/fixtures.py + art/level21/props21.py - offline generators for Level 0 props/stairs, Level 1 textures/door/breach/map and props, Level 2 fixtures, and Level 2.1 props.

places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-geo.js + scripts/zenith-breach-geo.js + scripts/zenith-door.js + scripts/zenith-bots.js + scripts/zenith-hatch.js + scripts/zenith-flicker.js + scripts/zenith-drones.js + scripts/zenith-use.js + scripts/zenith-scout.js - Zenith station/breach geometry, machinery, drones, and quest interactions.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout and fixtures with resident schedules/home claims.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - per-NPC role/dialogue/look/routine on shared meg-agent behavior.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/faces/hair/model/wardrobe data + art/human-cloth/{wardrobe.py,check-bust.py,compile_wardrobe.py,wardrobe-check.mjs} + art/human-head/* + art/human-hair/build.py - deterministic appearance and fitted clothing/head meshes.

scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/critter.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - shared human combat/gait, idles, head tracking, fidgets, expressions, and dialogue; scripts/smilers.js + scripts/lurkers.js independently implement room-patrol, listening pauses, and lost-player search with species-specific movement.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Teleport Station travel derives from savePlace; level01 is named in hub/feed data and is not a solo home.
Found-item rarity gates apply only to found weapon tokens; existing weapon ownership/use and non-weapon loot are not level-gated. Search gating excludes storage and NPC containers.

Level 0 place.state.momentsV is 4: migration deletes old tagged moment entities before relaying them; preserve deterministic route/arrow direction logic. Level 0 sim sweeps loose ammo once under shellsSwept and no longer seeds floor shells.

Footstep surface detection checks visible geometry within 0.45 m before collider; terrain chunk hits use terrain.materialAt. Keep material words/tags and mapping priority in scripts/lib/data/footsteps.yml.

Level 2 l2props.yml sizes are metres; fitBox places its mesh collider from floor y=0. Props spawn static to avoid falling through before floor mesh cooking. Level 2.1 revisioned rebuild preserves generated placement identity.

Smiler/lurker patrol and search targets use cellAt/cellCenter and stepToward0; sampled goals reject hub cells and pits, and search state is temporary before wandering resumes. Zenith entry uses place.state.zenEntryV=3 and removes tagged legacy breach/tape entities before relaying the bulkhead and stanchions; preserve doorway collider opening dimensions (1.5 x 2.3 m) and doorleaf alignment.
